name: Capitol Reef National Park
policyReason: The pets page opens part of the Fremont River Trail to leashed pets, so trails, not roads.
summary: Leashed pets may walk the Fremont River Trail to Hattie's Field, plus roads, the campground, orchards and parking lots.

excerpts.quote: on the Fremont River Trail from the campground to the south end of Hattie's Field (where there is a gate)
Pets are not permitted on other hiking trails, in public buildings, or in the backcountry.

dogRules.text: Walk pets on roads, the picnic area, campground and parking lots.
Leashed pets are allowed in the orchards.
